title: docs(qa): checklist items for the ADR-0146 Studio door promises (#28579 slice 2)

_Requested by **田騏** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi?thread=cmsg_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi9paTx1Lu8ENYwwssthfK3h)_

Part of #28579 (slice 2 of 3)

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：测试清单为 ADR-0146 已上线的「Studio 定制」能力各补了一条可执行测试项，共 7 条新项。它们覆盖：视图、仪表盘和报表的定制与恢复，流程覆盖，`__c` 扩展字段，定制配对包的创建入口，`os migrate` 迁移仪式，落地页计数，以及 Setup 到 Studio 的跳转。另有 1 条旧项扩展、1 条退役、5 条改写。只改 `docs/qa/platform-checklist`，不动产品代码。
- **为什么改**：这些能力已经交付，但清单里没有对应的测试项。上一片留下的几条旧项还写着已关闭的「无包覆盖」或已退役的 Setup 页面，QA 照着跑会得到错误结论。
- **风险与回滚**：纯文档与清单数据，不影响运行时。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：`studio-authoring.package-customize-restore-display`（新主项，替代退役的 `packaged-display-class-direct-edit`），以及 FOLLOW-UPS §14b（卸载基础包时先返回 422，不会走到点名配对包的 409）。
- **两分钟验证**：`node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs` 为绿，符号锚点从 1096/1106 增至 1134/1144，未解析的仍是原有 10 个。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地

## What changes

There are seven new items, one per ADR-0146 promise. Each was read from source at `eb123b7ccc` and cites the card that shipped it.

| Item | Promise |
| --- | --- |
| `studio-authoring.package-customize-restore-display` | N-17: Customize, the five reads agree, the end user sees it, export, Restore package original. Variants for view, dashboard and report |
| `automation.package-flow-override` | N-11 / N-18 / N-22: a flow override in the pair, the waiting run finishes on the base, the ledger switch is inherited, Restore re-arms the base, New similar is a separate copy |
| `studio-authoring.package-extension-field-c` | N-23c: an `__c` field on a base object through `object_extension` in the pair, the label-only `fieldPatches` whitelist, the two `__c` refusals |
| `platform-core.customization-pair-ensure-door` | N-13 / N-14: `POST /packages/:id/ensure-customization` (201, idempotent 200, every refusal) and the pair's uninstall refusal |
| `cli.packageless-overlay-ceremony-and-close` | N-16a / N-16b: `os migrate packageless-overlays` preview, confirmation, apply, then the closed package-less write (403 `NOT_OVERRIDABLE` naming the pair) |
| `studio-authoring.package-customization-counts-and-marks` | N-24 / N-26b: the landing's "n customized, m switched off", the directory marks and filter |
| `platform-core.setup-metadata-redirects-to-studio` | N-28: Setup metadata URLs land in Studio in one hop, keeping package, review and hash; the datasource stays in Setup |

Existing items changed. Every one bumps `revision` and adds a `history` row that says why.

- `studio-authoring.access-permission-set-lifecycle` (r5→r6) is **extended rather than twinned** with N-20b, New similar on a packaged set: new steps[6] and acceptance[5]. The copy lands in `com.example.showcase.custom`, and no override gesture is offered (D6).
- `studio-authoring.packaged-display-class-direct-edit` is **retired** (r6→r7) with `supersededBy` the new display item. Its `retiredReason` maps every clause.
- `studio-authoring.org-override-registry-gate` (r8→r9): the "overlay open" side is now the declared override from the pair. The transitional knownGap is replaced.
- The four FOLLOW-UPS §13c items now name the Studio landing URL instead of the retired Setup page:
  - `platform-core.metadata-authoring-roundtrip` (r8→r9). Its acceptance[4] wording no longer says a packaged view "accepts" a package-less overlay. The verify is unchanged.
  - `studio-authoring.record-page-roundtrip` (r12→r13)
  - `studio-authoring.permission-matrix-editor-ux` (r8→r9)
  - `automation.packaged-flow-subflow-disable-refusal` (r11→r12)
- `coverage.json`: the retired id is re-mapped, and the new items are mapped under report, flow, object and manifest.
- `FOLLOW-UPS.md` gets §14.

Left alone, as the order says: `api-backend.packaged-action-disabled-dispatch` and `automation.packaged-flow-disable-durable`, whose knownGap waits on #29374.

## Tests

No product code changes. Each new item's `automated.ref` names the unit and integration pins below. They were run on this branch (see Verification).

- UI (jsdom):
  - studio-design: InterfacesPillar.customize-28562, StudioCustomizeControls.customize-28562, StudioDesignSurface.customizePublish-28562, AutomationsPillar.customizeFlow-28570, AutomationsPillar.newSimilar-28567, DataPillar.baseObjectExtension-28575, StudioCustomizeControls.objectExtension-28575, BuilderLanding.customizationCounts-28566, customizationMarks, setupMetadataRedirect, noSetupMetadataLink-28578
  - metadataAreaHost.customizations-28568
  - AppContent.setupMetadataStudio-28578
  - StudioDesignSurface.accessNewSimilar-28573, for the extended access item
- Server:
  - objectql: protocol-custom-override-effective-read, registry-assert-package-uninstallable, protocol-packageless-overlay-migration
  - service-automation: flow-sync-one-precedence
  - runtime: packages-ensure-customization, packages-uninstall-refuse-before-mutate, packages-customizations, permission-set-clone
  - metadata-protocol: protocol.named-base-overlay-write, protocol.extension-field-suffix
  - cli: packageless-overlays.integration

## Acceptance notes

- **Seat decision: the retire.** The order says to retire `packaged-display-class-direct-edit` only if a new item covers every clause. The successor covers [0]–[3]. [4] (a packaged flow stays locked) is held by `packaged-automation-studio-lock` and the new flow-override item. The dashboard leg's specimen moves from the platform's `system_overview` (plugin-auth) to the showcase's `showcase_ops_dashboard`, and nothing here verifies whether a platform-shipped dashboard can be customized.
- **Measured from source (FOLLOW-UPS §14b).** `DELETE /api/v1/packages/:id` runs `requireWritablePackage` before `assertPackageUninstallable`. So uninstalling the showcase (a read-only base) answers **422 `WRITABLE_PACKAGE_REQUIRED`**, and the pair is never asked. The 409 that names the pair is reachable only for a writable base with an exported pair, and the ensure-door item scores both. Slice 3's live spec should expect 422 on the showcase.
- **The ceremony needs a staged row.** No door on main writes a package-less row any more, which is what the close means. The CLI item's knownGap says how a run stages one, the way the command's own integration test does.
- **Out of scope, reported (FOLLOW-UPS §14c).** Studio's landing copy (`engine.studio.landing.description` and `readonlyHint`) still says "customize them with an environment overlay". `BuilderLanding.environmentOverlayCopy-12171.test.ts` pins that phrase. This was found by reading source only.
- The browser journeys have no live e2e spec yet. #28579 slice 3 owes it, and the four browser items say so in `automated.ref`.

## Verification

Run on the branch head after merging `origin/main` (`04e0c2c0c7`). Each exit code was recorded before any pipe, and heavy runs went through `os-verify-lock.sh`.

- `node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs`: exit 0. 16 areas, 359 items. Symbol anchors resolved 1134/1144 (base 1096/1106), so all 38 new anchors resolve and the #16898 residual is unchanged at 10. Line citations: 0.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`: 16 commands, each exit 0. `--ran` reports 16 derived, 16 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. The first pass had `check:doc-formula-expressions` exit 3 (lint not built). It was green after the build, and the reconciled list is the second pass.
- UI pins: `cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=1 …` over the 14 files above: exit 0, 14 files, 242 tests.
- Server pins (`pnpm exec vitest run` per package): all exit 0, nothing skipped.
  - objectql: 3 files, 42 tests
  - service-automation: 1 file, 16 tests
  - runtime: 4 files, 97 tests
  - metadata-protocol: 2 files, 41 tests
  - cli: 1 integration file, 3 tests
- Changed lines: +807 / −39 across 6 files under `docs/qa/platform-checklist/`, within the slice's budget.
- `skip-changeset`: docs and checklist only, nothing published.
